properties.name: app.environment
properties.description: Deployment environment written to the 'env' field of every log line, e.g. local, docker, k8s.

properties.name: app.logging.format
properties.description: Console log format: 'json' (one JSON object per line, for log shipping) or 'text' (human-readable).

properties.name: app.logging.async.queue-size
properties.description: Capacity of the asynchronous logging queue; when it is 80% full, TRACE/DEBUG/INFO events are dropped first.

properties.name: app.logging.max-message-length
properties.description: Maximum length of the 'message' field of a JSON log line; longer messages are cut.

properties.name: app.logging.max-stack-trace-length
properties.description: Maximum length of the 'stackTrace' field of a JSON log line.

properties.name: app.logging.access.slow-request-threshold
properties.description: Requests that take at least this long are written to the access log at WARN level.

values.description: Colored human-readable lines for local development and tests.
